discomName: Jaipur Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd (JVVNL, RERC)

connectionTypes.sourceNote: JAIPUR Discom (JVVNL) "Tariff for Supply of Electricity-2025", Schedule NDS/LT-2 (Non-Domestic Service), consumers above 5kW sanctioned load (PRIMARY-hosted copy, https://cescrajasthan.co.in/kedl/pages/event/uploads/Tariff-2025%202.pdf). Fixed charge shown (Rs.160/kW/month) applies to consumption up to 500 units/month; it rises to Rs.200/kW/month (or Rs.320/kVA of billing demand if SCL>18.65kW) above 500 units/month. Consumers with sanctioned load up to 5kW instead pay a flat Rs.350-700/connection/month fixed charge (not modelled here). This may reflect a more detailed/current schedule than the file's existing residential entry, which is separately marked as a secondary-sourced approximation pending primary cross-check.

JAIPUR Discom (JVVNL) "Tariff for Supply of Electricity-2025", Schedule LT-5 (Small Industries, connected load up to 25 HP / 18.65 kW) (PRIMARY-hosted copy, https://cescrajasthan.co.in/kedl/pages/event/uploads/Tariff-2025%202.pdf). Flat energy charge of Rs.6.00/unit regardless of consumption. Fixed charge quoted as Rs.90/HP/month for consumption up to 500 units/month (converted here to Rs./kW using 1 HP = 0.746 kW); it rises to Rs.150/HP/month above 500 units/month.

JAIPUR Discom (JVVNL) "Tariff for Supply of Electricity-2025", Schedule AG/MS/LT-4 (Agriculture Service, Metered Supply), "General"/block-hours-supply category (PRIMARY-hosted copy, https://cescrajasthan.co.in/kedl/pages/event/uploads/Tariff-2025%202.pdf). Fixed charge quoted as Rs.30/HP/month, converted here to Rs./kW using 1 HP = 0.746 kW. Consumers taking supply beyond block hours instead pay Rs.7.00/unit with a fixed charge of Rs.60/HP/month (not modelled here).

verifiedBy: SOURCED (secondary) — Rajasthan domestic tariff from secondary references; pending primary SERC order cross-check. Rajasthan’s per-unit electricity duty (~40 paise/unit) and urban cess are not modelled here.
